intro.title: One Skala family: rooms by the sea, a captain at the helm
intro.body:
Captain Vangelis Spathis was born in Spathi, a village 5 km from Skala, and has worked at sea since he was 18. His day cruises have sailed from Skala since 1987.

With his wife Frosso he also looks after guests on land: at Aegealis Studios, across the road from the beach, and at Theodora Studios & Apartments, at the top of the village. Many guests come back, some for the fourth time.

properties.title: Two places to stay, two sides of Skala
properties.intro: Pick the beach or the village. Either way, you get the same family, daily cleaning and 20% off every scheduled cruise.

aegealis.title: Aegealis Studios
aegealis.pitch: Studios and apartments across the road from Skala beach, with a lawned garden and palms. You can use the pools of the hotels on either side, and the Captain's cruises board right in front.
aegealis.best: Best for: beach days, couples, sea views

theodora.title: Theodora Studios & Apartments
theodora.pitch: Studios and apartments at the top of Skala's main street, about 100 m from the centre, with a shady garden and an orange tree at the back. The beach is a 5–10 minute walk downhill, and a gate from the garden leads to the neighbouring hotel's pool (subject to the hotel's season).
bullets: Two-bedroom apartment for up to five
theodora.best: Best for: families, groups, walking to tavernas

cruises.title: Sail from Skala beach to Ithaca, Fiscardo or Zakynthos
cruises.body: NIRIIS, the Captain's sixth boat, was built in 2017 and has stabilisers that cut rolling by up to 70%, plus a water slide and a diving platform. Every scheduled cruise stops for a swim, and the Ithaca cruises stop twice.

cruises.discount: Staying with us? 20% off every scheduled cruise.

story.title: His first love was the sea
story.body:
Vangelis Spathis was born in Spathi in 1952. He was four when he first saw the sea, and he never got over it. At 18 he finally went to sea. He joined the navy in 1974 and, in 1984, after years of sailing to ports around the world, he earned his Master's licence.

A year later he fell in love with Frosso and had to choose: a captain's life far from home, or a life close to his family. He found a middle way. In 1987 he started daily cruises from Skala with TARA. Thirty years and five boats later came NIRIIS, in 2017.

Every year, about four in ten of his passengers have sailed with him before. Aegealis and Theodora run on the same welcome: a family that meets you on arrival, arranges your taxi and tells you where to eat.
story.quote: Now I feel that I have three loves: my family, the sea and all of you.

map.intro: From Aegealis the beach is 20 m away and the village centre about 500 m. From Theodora the supermarket is a minute's walk and the beach about 500 m.

contact.title: A real person answers: one of the family
contact.body: Message us on WhatsApp, call or email, and ask anything before you book. We speak English, Greek and some Spanish.
contact.kiosk: Or stop at the cruise kiosk in front of Aegealis during the season, the same spot where you board the boat.
